_doc: Lookout Mountain Lariat V3 for tools/ship_track.sh (V3-PLAN P1; ledger 0048), wired for DRIVE 1 (2026-10-12): 'the road and the ground, nothing else', street_full + street_reverse (the race layouts are parked in track.config.json layouts_parked until Drive 3). The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso (the sync rails require it). The draft order is plan P2 step 1 with the paint centreline wired in: gps (the OSM line; the paint line it overwrites is kept as data/centerline.previous.geojson first) -> paint_centreline (data/centerline.geojson becomes the paint line again) -> remap_config (--write: every vertex index and station in the config follows the line, by station matching) -> verify_centreline_paint (the hairpin / paint gate, hard) -> route_oneway_check (hard) -> elev (heightfield: the 3DEP samples) -> road_profile (the profile smoothed by station, the declared lid held straight, capture.bridges written) -> project -> widths (the mountain OSM table) -> measured_widths (aerial > published > OSM, local frame) -> crossfall (footprint, estimated) -> verify_crossfall (roll rate, hard), so no OSM geometry ever reaches elevation or projection. The draft ends with underlay (scripts/blender/underlay.py, P2 step 3): it builds or refreshes loop.blend's GEN_* layers (GEN_road 1ROAD_road, GEN_verge 1RUNOFF_verge, GEN_terrain 1GRASS_terrain_placeholder until P3a's tiers, GEN_refs) and never resets the scene or touches AUTH_*. The D4 edge is chosen per run: no SHIP_VARIANT = the config as written (a_real_edge, verge 0.4 m, installs lookout_lariat_v3); SHIP_VARIANT=b_verge = the 1.25 m firm gravel strip (installs lookout_lariat_v3_verge, never synced back). The prep, exporter and spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac (never engine-july: that is San Diego's alone). Gates (P5's Drive-1 set): the draft's hard gates above; verify_kn5 + verify_inis (hard, ship phase); then on the built road kn5_ground_check (hard, kn5-internal: it runs before road_obj writes the gate OBJ) -> road_obj -> drive_test_drive1 (per street layout) -> audit_street (hard) -> road_inventory (hard) -> stacked_legs (hard) -> drive1_verdict (tools/drive1_gates.py: the Drive-1 thresholds on every report, gating vs recorded, and the July reference that --force-install must not be worse than).
_owed: Not in the Drive-1 chain, by design: the AI lines (ship step 'ai': Drive 3, A13, and then one in-game recording per layout); TreeFX ('treefx': Drive 2, and make_treefx still reads San Diego's zones); the race steps (_drive3_steps); the P3 authoring steps (seat_terrain with station matching, terrain_cutfill, the tiers, overpass_decks, mouths / stubs / the lid, hairpin_pads, edges, signs, lamps, buildings) are not listed at all yet. With them, 'drive_test_drive1' and 'drive1_verdict' stay; 'race_gates' and the race author steps come back when the race layouts are unparked.

_drive3_steps._doc: Drive 3 (A13): unpark the race layouts (track.config.json layouts_parked -> layouts[]) and restore these, in this order. Each still runs San Diego's shape (tools/barrier_bands.py exits 1 on this config on 2026-10-12: 'edge folds at v12858 and v12867 overlap — author this corner by hand'); P1 owes the config race block that replaces SD's hard-coded STREETS.
